programme.title: Pak-Rat
programme.desc: Spencer devient accro à un jeu-vidéo et Carly doit intervenir. De son côté, Sam fait croire à Freddie qu'il est maudit pour avoir refusé de transmettre une lettre chaîne.

programme.title: Pour une poignée de dollars
programme.desc: Sam se sent insultée quand Freddie l'accuse de ne pas rembourser l'argent qu'elle emprunte. Du coup elle va tout faire pour effacer ses dettes. Voyant le travail qu'elle fournit, Sam et Carly décident de l'aider secrètement.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Cest pas de la tarte
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Spencer emmènent Freddie dans leur boutique de tartes préférée. A leur arrivée, ils apprennent que le propriétaire a disparu en emportant la recette des tartes avec lui.

programme.title: Spencer est normal
programme.desc: Alors qu'il souhaite pimenter un peu la tradition de Noël avec un arbre peu conventionnel, Spencer met accidentellement le feu aux cadeaux de Carly. Bouleversée, elle rêve d'avoir un frère normal.

programme.title: Le premier baiser
programme.desc: Alors que Freddie confie à Carly qu'il n'a jamais embrassé une fille, Sam surprend leur conversation et dévoile le secret de Freddie sur Internet.

programme.title: Le concours
programme.desc: L'équipe organise un concours sur iCarly.com pour gagner une voiture.

programme.title: Meilleurs ennemis
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie vexent une starlette du web dénommée Fred. Ce dernier tente alors de convaincre ses abonnés vidéo de ne plus jamais regarder iCarly.

programme.title: Trop jeune pour ça
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités à assister à un combat d'arts martiaux pour filmer en coulisses. Mais Spencer et Mrs Benson refusent de les laisser y aller.

programme.title: Que le meilleur chante
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie demandent aux fans d'iCarly de voter pour David Archuleta afin qu'il remporte AMERICA SINGS. Mais ils se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport au deuxième et l'aident à créer son clip.

programme.title: Sam devient gentille
programme.desc: Sam craque sur un garçon qui n'aime que les filles très féminines. Carly aide alors Sam à se relooker.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: La meilleure amie
programme.desc: Missy Robinson, l'ancienne amie de Carly, revient dans sa vie. Sam se sent alors mise de côté.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie perdent l'URL iCarly au profit de Nevel. Ce dernier demande à Carly de l'embrasser en échange de l'URL. De son côté, Spencer s'amuse avec les deux cent oreillers qu'il a commandés par erreur...

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: Cercle Infernal
programme.desc: La vie de deux sœurs change radicalement, depuis qu'elles ont été hypnotisées par un disque vinyle mystique des années 1970.

programme.title: Aux Portes De L'Enfer
programme.desc: Le révérend Jonah Johnson et sa femme Isabelle sont des télé-évangélistes arnaqueurs. Repérés par la police, ils doivent partir pour Los Angeles. Afin d'habiter un vieux manoir abandonné, ils acceptent un marché avec une vieille femme très riche, Lady Calagari. Le couple devra ériger un culte à la gloire de Satan. Dès lors, des événements surnaturels font leur apparition et des meurtres inexpliqués s'enchaînent.

programme.title: Time served
programme.desc: Quand un enfant tue son beau-père violent, sa mère se dénonce et est condamnée à une longue peine de prison.

programme.title: Big Foot
programme.desc: En 1970, deux hommes aux destins opposés : Harley Anderson et Simon Quint doivent s'unir pour chasser une créature légendaire vivant dans les montagnes : le `Big foot'.

programme.title: L'Odyssée d'Albert: Chapitre 1
programme.desc: Chris, un adolescent aventureux, aide un gentil dinosaure à échapper aux griffes d'un scientifique fou, le docteur Jost, qui veut utiliser l'animal à des fins d'expérimentation.

programme.title: A.R.I
programme.desc: Noah, un jeune garcon un peu geek, découvre un robot qui semble abandonné dans une poubelle du laboratoire où travaille son père. Il le ramène à la maison et tente de le réparer.

programme.title: Foxter & Max
programme.desc: Un pré-adolescent artistique et frustré découvre que le chien graffiti qu'il a peint avec une boîte trouvée de ce qu'il pensait être de la peinture en aérosol, a pris vie sous la forme d'un super-chien ultra-intelligent fait de nanobots.

programme.title: Marshall, le Miracle de la vie
programme.desc: Finn, jeune garçon de 12 ans, et sa mère célibataire toujours stressée Cynthia, viennent d'emménager dans une nouvelle ville pour commencer une nouvelle vie. Cependant Finn a quelques difficultés à s'intégrer. Un jour tout change : Finn rencontre un labrador nommé Marshall.

programme.title: Bobby et les Chasseurs de fantômes
programme.desc: Sanne, 13 ans, raffole des histoires fantastiques que lui raconte son père, Lucas, un chasseur de spectres très réputé.

programme.title: Burner
programme.desc: Kiki, mère célibataire tout juste sortie de prison, pense enfin pouvoir repartir à zéro avec sa fille. Mais le retour de son ex, un dealer violent, fait voler sa nouvelle vie en éclats. Pour se sauver elle-même et protéger sa fille, Kiki doit trouver un moyen de se débarrasser de son ex… et de s'en tirer sans être inquiétée.

programme.title: La loi de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Un ancien détenu se voit entraîné dans une brutale guerre de territoire avec la mafia Russe, ce qui le force à replonger dans son passé trouble afin d'utiliser les techniques de survie apprises dans l'une des plus violentes prisons.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Dans une société totalitaire née après une pandémie dévastatrice, chaque citoyen doit accepter un contrat lui garantissant vingt ans de sécurité avant une mort programmée. À quelques jours de son échéance, Tala se lance dans un ultime combat pour empêcher sa fille de devenir à son tour prisonnière de ce système impitoyable.

programme.title: Follow Me
programme.desc: Un vloggeur américain se rend à Moscou avec des amis pour participer à un escape game extrême qui repousse toutes les limites. Alors que la frontière entre jeu et réalité se fait de plus en plus floue, le groupe doit se battre pour s'échapper et survivre.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Lorsque James, un chauffeur Uber, et sa passagère Jessica, passent prendre le charismatique mais néanmoins manipulateur Bruno, leur trajet dans Los Angeles se transforme en une véritable lutte psychologique pour survivre.

programme.title: Regarder Oana
programme.desc: Oana travaille. Et moi je la regarde. Ce soir, ce dernier dossier sera plié. Elle ne veut plus traduire les mots des autres. Elle pense que demain elle va commencer à écrire pour elle. Mais elle ne le fera pas. Je le sais....

programme.title: Bleu-Gris
programme.desc: Fin août. Corse. Elbe, dix-sept ans, sourde de naissance est en vacances chez sa grande sœur Mathilde. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au phare de la Revellata, elle aperçoit un homme qui remonte seul d'une plongée sous marine…

programme.title: Rase campagne
programme.desc: Un village perdu dans la campagne finistérienne. Un homme est suspecté d'être porteur du virus Ebola. Il est noir. C'est Maurice. Son meilleur ami, Michel, ambulancier, sillonne le territoire avec son stagiaire Rémi pour le retrouver et le contrôler…

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Traversées
programme.desc: Ca tourne, ça virevolte, ça chute... sur la patinoire. Agile ou grotesque, chacun s'essaie à l'art du patinage. Le film est une ode. Ode à cette vie précaire, ode à cette arène où tant de personnes sont passées pour une heure, une journée, un amour...

programme.title: The Face, The Heel... et Corentin
programme.desc: Corentin est un nouvel élève du catch club de Cognac. Réservé, sincère et persévérant, le jeune homme se donne à fond pour atteindre son objectif : lutter aux Etats-Unis ou à l'étranger. Mais a-t-il l'étoffe d'un catcheur pour y parvenir ?

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood ne veut pas mourir
programme.desc: Dans une demeure isolée, Susan Aylwood, ancienne star du cinéma, vit avec sa gouvernante la discrète Caroline. Entourée de ses souvenirs de gloire, elle mène son entourage à la baguette. Mais quelle terrible vérité se cache derrière les apparences ?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia est entraînée dans un appartement pour une fête. Face à la foule de visages, elle est sans repères, comme perdue dans un paysage de montagne recouvert de nuages.

programme.title: Garage rouge
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon n'ose plus sortir de chez lui après une agression.

programme.title: A perdre haleine
programme.desc: Emile, jeune violoncelliste, est submergé par l'angoisse le jour d'un concert...

programme.title: Léon d'Oural
programme.desc: Au cours d'une prestigieuse course, des chevaux, poussés par les jockeys, enchaînent avec vigueur les obstacles.

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Blanche
programme.desc: Un homme part de la vallée, pour aller chercher des glaciers, des sommets. Il fuit un monde bruyant, polluant. Un monde qui fait fondre les glaciers, qui les réchauffent et les fait disparaître. Il monte, s'éloigne et toujours, pourtant, il sait que le monde d'en bas le poursuit.

programme.title: Papa dans maman
programme.desc: Milieu de la nuit. Des gémissements se font entendre derrière la porte des parents. Deux jeunes soeurs s'interrogent...

programme.title: Le quepa sur la vilni !
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, André sort de sa paisible retraite . Sur ordre du maire, il doit mener à travers monts une troupe d'hommes-sandwichs à vélo pour attirer les spectateurs à l'inauguration du cinéma local.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s'est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l'arrestation d'un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l'élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c'est l'occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l'exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu'il mérite toujours son titre d'homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu'il n'a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Une femme est kidnappée et forcée de participer à des combats souterrains d'élite et doit se frayer un chemin vers la liberté.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: Sarah Winchester, riche héritière de l'entreprise d'armes Winchester Rifle, construit une maison après la mort tragique de son mari et son fils. Elle croit que sa famille est maudite par les fantômes de tous ceux tués par ses armes et construit donc une maison pendant 38 ans pour y emprisonner les mauvais esprits. Eric Price, un psychiatre au passé trouble, est engagé pour déterminer si Sarah Winchester est folle, ou pas…

programme.title: Monsieur Lazhar
programme.desc: À Montréal, une enseignante du primaire meurt subitement. Bachir Lazhar, un immigrant algérien, est rapidement embauché pour la remplacer alors qu'il nage lui-même en pleine tragédie personnelle. Il apprend peu à peu à connaître un groupe d'enfants attachants, malgré le fossé culturel qui se manifeste dès la première leçon. Pendant que la classe amorce un processus de guérison, personne à l'école ne soupçonne le passé douloureux de Bachir, qui risque l'expulsion du pays à tout moment. Adapté d'une pièce de théâtre d'Evelyne de la Chenelière, Monsieur Lazhar met en images la rencontre de deux mondes et la puissance de la parole. Philippe Falardeau y suit avec humour et sensibilité un homme humble prêt à transcender sa propre perte pour aider les écoliers à vaincre le silence qui les emmure.

programme.title: Poisson D'avril
programme.desc: Emile, un mécanicien apprécié mais un brin naïf, se laisse convaincre par un vendeur insistant et lui achète un attirail de pêche. Préférant cacher cette dépense déraisonnable à sa femme, Emile s'éclipse pour tester le matériel chez une cousine, Annette. Une série de quiproquos improbables les obligent à prétendre que tous deux forment un couple.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Ben emménage dans une nouvelle maison. L'adolescent se lie d'amitié avec leur nouveau voisin, qui est en fait le célèbre magicien Merlin. Alors que ce dernier affronte la terrible fée Morgane, il enseigne à Ben les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: Joe Baby
programme.desc: Chargée de récupérer 10 millions de dollars disparus dans une sombre affaire immobilière, Joe Baby, détective privée, se retrouve entraînée dans une affaire où tout semble ramener à la mort mystérieuse de son père, Walter Baby.

programme.title: Le pacte du mal
programme.desc: Diego est un médecin habitué à traiter des situations extrêmes. Si bien qu'il devient totalement immunisé à la douleur des autres. Quand Sara, une de ses patientes, tente de se suicider, son partenaire accuse Diego.

programme.title: La Panthère Rose
programme.desc: Un célèbre entraîneur de football est assassiné et sa bague, ornée du fameux diamant ‘'La Panthère Rose'' a disparu. L'inspecteur en chef Dreyfuss confie l'enquête à l'inspecteur Jacques Clouseau, le plus maladroit, le plus empoté, le plus incapable des agents de police.

programme.title: Bye Bye Love
programme.desc: En 1963 à New York, une chroniqueuse d'une rubrique pour femmes qui a renoncé à l'amour tombe amoureuse d'un journaliste séducteur qui a décidé de la piéger.

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Julia Roberts, lauréate d'un Oscar, brille dans ce film au casting étourdissant : Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal et l'oscarisée Marcia Gay Harden.

programme.title: Wishmaster
programme.desc: Le producteur exécutif Wes Craven nous livre ce classique culte de fantaisie-horreur qui a donné lieu à trois suites. Lorsqu'une experte en joaillerie reçoit une pierre précieuse ancienne, elle libère involontairement un esprit immortel qui réalise les vœux des humains en échange de leur âme.

programme.title: Wishmaster 2: Le mal ne meurt jamais
programme.desc: Le mal a été invoqué une fois de plus lorsque le Djinn maléfique est réveillé par un cambrioleur nommé Morgane (Fields) lors d'un hold-up d'art bâclé.Lorsque le Djinn prend la responsabilité du crime, il est envoyé en prison où il exauce des souhaits aux prisonniers en échange de leurs âmes, pour finalement structurer une armée pour anéantir toute l'humanité.C'est à Morgane de sauver la race humaine.

programme.title: Les condamnes 2
programme.desc: Randy Orton et Eric Roberts mettent le feu aux poudres dans cette suite explosive des Condamnés. Après que leur mission échoue pour capturer le chef d'un réseau de paris illégaux, Will Tanner, un chasseur de primes, devient la proie — la cible humaine d'un jeu où les concurrents doivent tuer ou être tués.

programme.title: Arnold le magnifique
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger est la star de ce documentaire des 100 jours qui ont précédé le concours M. Olympia en 1975. Cinq fois champion du monde, Schwarzenegger s'oppose à Lou Ferrigno (acteur dans la série télévisée L'Incroyable Hulk), nouveau venu et timide, dans une confrontation aussi mentale que physique. Grace à sa guerre psychologique, son intense détermination, ses dérapages verbaux, et son charme qui a fait de lui une célébrité, « Arnold le magnifique » a changé le monde du bodybuilding et lancé la carrière des deux hommes.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Le radio-astronome Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) croit avoir capté un bruit cosmique qui signale l'intelligence extraterrestre. Sa recherche désespérée de réponses l'amène au Mexique à une centrale nucléaire mystérieuse, où il est arrêté pour le meurtre d'un scientifique. Zane doit échapper prouvant l'invasion extraterrestre dans ce thriller intense de science-fiction.

programme.title: A Battle of wits
programme.desc: Une fresque retraçant la série de guerres civiles qui construisit la nation chinoise du cinquième siècle au troisième siècle avant J-C

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: D'après la légende, dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, des forces saxonnes venues de l'Est attaquent le peuple celte. Mais tout n'est pas perdu. Arthur, un guerrier banni, et Merlin, un sorcier ermite, s'unissent, tels des héros, pour sauver le peuple.

programme.title: Sharknado 5 : Global Swarming FR
programme.desc: Spécialistes du combat contre les requins, Fin et Nova explorent un temple souterrain situé sous Stonehenge. Des peintures leur apprennent que l'Humanité a déjà été confrontée aux Sharknado pendant la préhistoire…

programme.title: Coup de Foudre Mode dEmploi
programme.desc: Un écrivain rencontre par hasard l'amour de sa vie et découvre que la jeune femme est fiancée.

programme.desc: La mise en scène de Destin Daniel Cretton offre plus d'intensité et d'élégance à ce Spider-Man.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez joue le rôle d'une fille ordinaire dont le voyage d'été à Paris se transforme en rêve de sa vie lorsqu'elle devient une princesse accidentelle en assumant l'identité d'une autre personne.

programme.title: Coup de Foudre: Mode d'Emploi
programme.desc: Werther, un jeune écrivain insouciant et charmant, rencontre Charlotte, l'amour de sa vie. Mais il découvre qu'elle est fiancée. Contre l'avis de son meilleur ami, Werther met son monde sens dessus dessous cultivant l'espoir de conquérir le cœur de sa compagne.

programme.title: Ma belle-sœur bien aimée
programme.desc: À l'occasion des 40 ans d'Audrey, son frère épouse une fille rencontrée en France. Les secrets sont révélés avant le mariage. Audrey et la jeune fiancée française ne s'entendent pas du tout !

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête.

programme.title: La Chanteuse Amoureuse
programme.desc: Une pop star frustrée par la gestion excessive de sa carrière, rêvant d'une vie ordinaire, se retrouve partagée entre son ex célèbre, les manigances de son manager autoritaire et une romance naissante avec un propriétaire de disquaire terre-à-terre.

programme.title: The Happiness Playbook
programme.desc: Des étincelles jaillissent lorsqu'une journaliste infiltrée commence à tomber amoureuse du sujet de son reportage.

programme.title: Flirt et Passe-Passe
programme.desc: Des jumelles identiques, Alice et Lacey, sont prises l'une pour l'autre lors d'une retraite. Elles décident de jouer le jeu le temps du séjour, mais réalisent bientôt qu'elles se sont peut-être trompées sur ce dont elles avaient réellement besoin dans leur vie.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Bucketlist Africa
programme.desc: Africa: one of the most iconic and diverse continents. It's packed with a spectacular range of habitats and environments, and home to some of the best loved and dramatic wildlife on the planet. From the small and surprising to the enormous and entertaining, there's something for everyone's bucket list on this vast continent. From camels to giraffes, gorillas to buffalo, the sheer range of wildlife found in Africa is unbelievable. With so much to see, where would you begin your bucket list adventure?

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E01
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E04
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.desc: Squirt is captured by a Tooth Troll who claims his baby tooth has enough power to summon all the teeth in the world. Then, Gretchen grows into a Queen Bee.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

programme.title: Masha's Tales

She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Dead Mans Cards
programme.desc: When Tom's boxing career abruptly ends, he's offered a job as a door man at a run down night club, where he meets Paul, a volatile man with a history of violence. Soon it is unclear whether Tom has taken a step on the road to redemption, or finally hit the self-destruct button. Paul takes Tom under his wing to teach him the ropes, but he is soon at deadly odds with violent gangsters from the area.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Medicine
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history's most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman's patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. “There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill,” the undertaker remembers. “It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn't quite fit.” Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan takes an unconscious Gayatri to the mosque where a Baba treats her. He asks Indravadhan about his whereabouts. Indravadhan does not reveal to the Baba that he is just a soldier. It is also revealed that Kuwar Singh's son has engaged in a gay relationship with a slave. Kuwar Singh scolds his son and asks him to keep in mind that, Indravadhan is not going to leave his throne. Kuwar Singh then asks his son to plan a baby as soon as possible. Kuwar Singh's son claims that he can do anything but will never plan a baby. What will Kuwar Singh's reaction be when he learns this? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri regains her consciousness and finds that Indravadhan's behavior has changed. Gayatri questions Indravadhan as to why he is doing this. Indravadhan claims that he is the one who has hurt her and it is his responsibility to take care of her. On the other hand, Kuwar's son beats up his wife and claims that he does not want to live with her. While Gayatri and Indravadhan on the other hand, are staying in the former's friend's place where they do not get sufficient food for two people. Indravadhan rejects from having the food and asks Gayatri to eat it alone. How will Gayatri convince Indravadhan to share the food? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan cries before Gayatri and claims that he had forgotten to fulfil the responsibility of a husband. Gayatri consoles Indravadhan by saying that he is a good person and knows how to fulfil the responsibilities as common man and as well as a king. Hearing this, Indravadhan leaves Gayatri and walks away. A confused Gayatri thinks as to what wrong she said to Indravadhan. On the other hand, Swarnlekha confronts Kuwar Singh and Kokila and shows her wounds to them. She tells her in-laws that she is going back to her home and is also going to complain about her husband. What will Kuwar Singh and Kokila do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Indravadhan finds Gayatri missing, he decides to search for her. On the other hand, Gayatri is held at gunpoint. She is then tied up to a chair by the baba and the family with whom Indravadhan and Gayatri were staying. Indravadhan too is held by the family and tied up to a wall. Later, Indravadhan questions Gayatri as to why she did not inform him about anything. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan that he was not ready to hear anything from her. On the other hand, Kuwar Singh and Kokila talk about Swarnlekha and her decision. They decide to talk with their son and convince him. While on the other hand, Gayatri and Indravadhan try to set themselves free and escape. Will Indravadhan and Gayatri be able to set themselves free? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Gayatri return home and they are confronted by Raj Mata. Raj Mata acts as though she does not know what actually had happened in the lives of Indravadhan and Gayatri. After the 'Aarti' the couple are welcomed in the house. Later, Indravadhan finds Gayatri struggling to tie a knot at her back. Indravadhan attends her and ties the knot up for her. On the other hand, Kokila meets Swarnlekha and threatens her. While on the other hand, Gayatri is suspicious as to how could Swarnlekha fall sick? Will Gayatri learn about Swarnlekha's condition? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj mata spots a spy in the Raj Mahal and follows her. She fails to catch up as the spy manages to evade Raj Mata. The spy then meets Kuwar Singh and gets some orders from him and meanwhile, Raj Mata informs Gayatri about the spy in the Raj Mahal. Later, Gayatri's brother meets her and invites her for an event being held at his home. When Gayatri's brother invites Raj Mata to the event, she declines the invitation. On hearing this, Indravadhan speaks up saying that he would attend the event. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji and Gayatri reach her house for the Pooja. When Gayatri asks whether he is still angry or not, Ranaji says that he left his anger outside. Kuwar's spy follows the two of them to keep an eye on them. Later Damyianti thanks Ranaj for accepting Gayatri as his wife and he is then asked to wear a dhoti for the Pooja. When he struggles with draping himself, Gayatri helps him. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek thi Rani to find out more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and realizes that Indravadhan has not yet returned. She decides to ask her mother where Indravadhan has gone. When Indravadhan comes back she confronts him and yells at him. Indravadhan apologizes to Gayatri and says that he failed to realize her importance in his life. He then puts a bangle around Gayatri's wrist and claims that he has given her all the rights as a queen, and as well as a wife. In return, Indravadhan requests Gayatri to forgive him. The next day, events are held at Gayatri's home in which both she and Indravadhan participate. What are the events that Indravadhan and Gayatri participate in? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds that her things are missing from her room she asks Ranaji who moved her things. programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Con la Planet Patrol fuori gioco, l'agente alieno Mogyar dovrà allearsi con un gruppo di umani e trovare il modo di fermare la creatura prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: Creature aliene simili a rettili volanti seminano il caos in tutto il mondo. L'unica speranza è un rivoluzionario caccia controllato con il pensiero, affidato a una squadra di militari che dovrà superare i propri limiti e affrontare in cielo un nemico apparentemente inarrestabile.

programme.title: Alienate
programme.desc: Una coppia in crisi decide di trascorrere il weekend separata. Ma quando aerei iniziano a precipitare e un'invasione aliena sconvolge il pianeta, Dave intraprende un viaggio disperato per tornare a casa e ritrovare la moglie, attraversando un mondo ormai precipitato nel caos.

programme.title: Alien Origin
programme.desc: Il filmato ritrovato di una spedizione militare scomparsa porta alla luce una scoperta sconvolgente. Tra giungla, rovine e segnali inspiegabili, la squadra si avvicina alla verità sull'origine della vita sulla Terra e a una presenza extraterrestre che non avrebbe mai dovuto incontrare.

programme.title: Alien Spider
programme.desc: Un gigantesco ragno alieno fugge da un laboratorio militare e semina il panico a Los Angeles. Quando l'esercito non riesce a fermarlo, la salvezza della città finisce nelle mani di un disinfestatore intraprendente e di un gruppo di scienziati pronti a tutto per abbattere la creatura.

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Una ragazza cieca riceve un trapianto di cornea per tornare a vedere. Tuttavia, si accorge presto di poter vedere tutto... anche fantasmi inquietanti.

programme.title: Broken
programme.desc: Una giovane donna fugge dal suo passato e fugge in Inghilterra in cerca di una nuova vita. Accetta un lavoro per prendersi cura di un tetraplegico, ma il peso del lavoro agita il suo passato. Sembra che i limiti della cura non siano sempre così chiari come dovrebbero essere

programme.title: Pawn
programme.desc: La storia di un gruppo di banditi armati che rapinano un ristorante e scoprono che appartiene alla mafia. Un piccolo furto si trasforma in un rapimento di alcuni ostaggi che si vedranno trascinati in una situazione che coinvolge un ex detenuto, i federali, la polizia locale e la mafia...

programme.title: Il viaggio di Norm
programme.desc: Norm, un orso bianco vegano e ballerino con la straordinaria capacità di parlare la lingua umana, deve lasciare il Polo Nord per raggiungere New York e fermare lo spietato costruttore Sig.

programme.title: Nut Job – Operazione Noccioline
